title: Maldives Couple Escape
headline: An island stay, unhurried, just the two of you.
description: Five nights in the Maldives: lagoon, house reef and meals arranged around how you like to spend a day at sea.
image_alt: Turquoise lagoon and overwater villas in the Maldives
price_label: Quoted for your island and dates
price_guidance: Maldives pricing depends on the atoll, villa type, meal plan and seaplane or speedboat transfer. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s island holiday with one resort stay. We shortlist properties for lagoon, privacy and dining — overwater or beach villa — then coordinate flights into Malé, the resort transfer and any spa or sunset-cruise add-ons you want.
highlights: One resort, five nights — no island-hopping unless you ask.
Villa category and meal plan chosen with you before booking.
Seaplane or speedboat transfers timed to your international flights.
Optional snorkel, spa and sunset cruise arranged on request.
why: Built for two: quiet beaches, house-reef mornings, unhurried evenings.
Dietary needs, including Jain or vegetarian, flagged to the resort in advance.
Visa-on-arrival guidance for Indian passports, coordinated with your tickets.
inclusions: Resort stay on the agreed meal plan
Return transfer from Velana International Airport as the resort operates it
Visa guidance for Indian passport holders
Concierge coordination of spa or excursion add-ons you approve
exclusions: International flights, unless added to your quote
Seaplane or speedboat supplements beyond the agreed transfer
Alcohol, spa treatments and paid water sports unless itemised
Travel insurance, GST and personal expenses

stay.name: Selected resort, villa category confirmed in writing
stay.room: Beach or overwater villa for two
amenities: House reef access where the island offers it

notes: Resort, villa type, meal plan and transfer mode are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. Seaplane seats follow the resort’s timetable. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: A single-island stay. Arrival and departure days flex around your Malé flights and the resort transfer.
